title: Re-centre the taxpayer portal on evidence requests and retire the claim form
scope: Make evidence requests the portal home, turn the submissions list into read-only My cases showing RSL's status labelled as RSL's, remove the New submission route and menu item from the product, and keep submit_refund_claim only as a labelled Online Refunds simulator for fixtures and the demo

acceptance.text: Portal home and first navigation item are Evidence requests; deep link /taxpayer/requests/:id works from an RSL screen after login
My cases is read-only, shows the RSL claim reference and RSL status with its source and a link to RSL's dashboard, and never shows risk or officer detail
The claim form and invoice entry are absent from the taxpayer product; the simulator is reachable only in fixture mode and labelled as an Online Refunds simulator
Screenshots at relevant viewports and accessibility checks per docs/DESIGN_STANDARD.md; record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Router and browser tests for the new navigation, deep link, absent routes and fixture-only simulator

notes.text: Added 2026-11-07 from ADR-043 (Vati downstream of RSL selection; portal answers evidence requests).
